messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High error rate + latency spike on routing service in eu-west and us-central. Trigger: routing-policy-eval-fail, 4xx/5xx surge. Root thread ts 2137418526
sarah: I got the page. Seeing 5xx up to 12% for requests that hit fallback path. Customers reporting timeouts.
devon: Confirmed in logs — lots of ‘unknown model variant’ errors when policy evaluator picks fallback variant.
anna_sre: Can someone paste the deploy that touched policy schema earlier today? I want to see what changed.
sarah: @devon pushed the schema change at 09:12UTC earlier, flagged as backwards compatible.
devon: That was the migration to versioned policy schema. We deprecated fallback_model field and added fallback_profile. We did a compatibility mapper but looks like mapper defaulted to a legacy marker that routes to model-legacy-v1.
leo_ml: model-legacy-v1 isn't hosted in eu-west. When policy picks it, router tries region fallback, then cycles through regions — that's our loop.
anna_sre: So config change -> deprecated field shadow -> incompatible default -> wrong variant -> region fallback loop -> latency spike. Good summary?
sarah: Yeah. Immediate ask: mitigate customer impact while we revert.
jay_oncall: I'm on pager. What's the quickest mitigation we can apply?
devon: We can push a routed override to force policies to use primary_model explicitly for active customers. Quick patch: `PATCH /v1/configs/{policy_id}` with `"fallback_profile": null, "force_model": "primary-model-v2"`
anna_sre: I'll prepare a temporary policy rollback to the last-known-good schema and deploy to control plane. Trying now.
ops_bot: Deploy started by anna_sre — rolling back policy schema mapper 2137380000 -> 2137241111. ETA ~90s.
sarah: While rollback is in progress, can we also add a rate-limit on fallback routing to stop the cascade?
devon: Adding a circuit-breaker on fallback path now: `cfg set routing.fallback.circuit_breaker=true threshold=5s`
leo_ml: Also recommend spinning up the eu-west replica for primary-model-v2 as a stopgap. I can trigger a model spinup but it takes ~6m to warm.
anna_sre: Rollback applied. I validated control-plane accepts old field interpretation. Monitoring shows error rate dropping but still elevated in us-central.
jay_oncall: Customer-impact check: which customers hit 5xx? @customer-success can you call out any paying accounts?
customer-success: I alerted top 10 enterprise customers. Two reported request failures: AcmePay and BrightHealth. Both are experiencing higher latencies and occasional timeouts but no data loss. They are on our priority list. Support tickets created.
sarah: Good. Let's keep one person on rotation to watch the support queue. @devon can you confirm the fallback loop stopped after rollback and circuit-breaker?
devon: Metrics: fallback attempts dropped 85% post-rollback, routing oscillation resolved. 5xx down to 1.2% from 12%. Latency tail improved.
ops_bot: Autoscaling note — we throttled scaleups during the loop to avoid overprovisioning; reverting now.
leo_ml: Warming eu-west replica completed. No more 'unknown model variant' errors observed for newly routed traffic.
jay_oncall: What's the next step for permanent fix?
sarah: Action items: 1) Revert incompatible mapper (devon) 2) Add unit tests for deprecated-field handling in policy schema (devon + leo_ml) 3) Add canary validation to schema deploy pipeline (anna_sre) 4) Customer comms & RCA draft (customer-success + sarah). Assign owners?
devon: I'll take #1 and #2.
anna_sre: I'll do #3 and schedule a postmortem meeting.
customer-success: I'll draft comms. Please add impact numbers once stable.
sarah: For the timeline, this was detected 09:45UTC, rollback completed 09:58UTC, major mitigation 10:05UTC, monitoring green 10:12UTC. Last message ts 2137418900.
jay_oncall: Closing pager for now, leaving monitoring watch for next hour. If anything spikes, page infra-sre.
leo_ml: Quick note — the deprecated field behavior was documented but not enforced in tests. We'll add a migration simulator to the CI that exercises deprecated->new mapping.
devon: Also adding a runtime safeguard: if chosen variant not available in region, prefer local primary_model instead of cross-region fallback.
sarah: Thanks everyone. Postmortem owner: anna_sre. Please include timeline, customer impact (AcmePay, BrightHealth), and remediation steps.
customer-success: I'll attach support tickets and customer quotes to the postmortem.
ops_bot: Incident closed by anna_sre pending postmortem. :white_check_mark:
sarah: :thumbsup: Great job coordinating. We'll run the RCA meeting tomorrow 15:00UTC.
